turnos.t: Environmental justice: the right of all people to live in a pollution-free environment and to have equitable access to natural resources, regardless of race, gender, age, socioeconomic status or nationality.

Bhopal, December 1984: toxic gas leaked from the Union Carbide pesticide plant; most victims were poor people living beside it, and compensation was slow and small. Grassy Narrows: from 1962 to 1970 a paper mill discharged mercury upstream, contaminating the fish the Anishinaabe community relied on. Agbogbloshie in Ghana: workers, including children, burning cables to recover copper. And the local case, Doñana, 1998: the Aznalcóllar tailings dam burst.
